about: Manual placement research for 9 Tambo press-only openings of REPORT.md §4 (Lima Norte / Este). Sources: Peru Retail trade press, OSM (Overpass/Nominatim, ODbL), the Carabayllo municipal license registry, RENIPRESS, the official Tambo (Justo) list in tools/seed/web/raw/tambo, and official short links resolved only through the HTTP Location header (coordinates, place label and the g_ep client-version date in the URL; no Google Maps page content). Every point was checked with tools/seed/pip.mjs.

possibleDuplicates: Tambo Carabayllo - Cjto. Hab. Edwin Vásquez Mz. Q Lt. 24 -> official TAMBO CHIMPU-OCLLO-C10 - CALLAO (web-tambo-chimpu-ocllo), 444 m, probable
Tambo Carabayllo - Mz. F -> official TAMBO JOSESACO-CARABAYLLO (web-tambo-josesaco), 2.4 km, weak
summary.note: No store is mapped in OSM yet (Overpass 2026-10-01). All are press-only openings (May-Aug 2026); keep to_verify.

reportRow.address: Mz. A Lt. 12, Urb. Santa Luisa

placements.method: None defensible: Urb. Santa Luisa (de Carabayllo) is not in OSM nor in Nominatim; the only located fact is that its Mz. A touches Av. Universitaria (municipal registry), a ~5 km stretch in Carabayllo.
evidence: Press: Peru Retail, 2026-07-09 (aperturas de junio) - https://www.peru-retail.com/tambo-suma-23-nuevos-locales-en-junio-y-queda-cerca-de-alcanzar-900-tiendas-a-nivel-nacional/ - "Carabayllo (2): Av. José Carlos Mariátegui 263 y Mz. A Lt. 12, Urb. Santa Luisa."
Nominatim 2026-10-01 "Santa Luisa, Carabayllo" -> no result; geocode cache "Mz. A Lt. 12, Urb. Santa Luisa, Carabayllo, Perú" -> no result.

Overpass 2026-10-01 (area Carabayllo r1944701): no element named Santa Luisa. The OSM "Urbanización Santa Luisa" (n13027251114, -11.950477,-77.067744; Galería/Capilla/C.C. Santa Luisa, IEI 0348 Santa Luisa) is in Comas/Los Olivos, ~6 km south: a different urbanization.

Municipalidad de Carabayllo, padrón de organizaciones y relación de licencias de funcionamiento (PDF) - https://web.municarabayllo.gob.pe/pte/padron_electoral-2018.pdf - license line: "URBANIZACION SANTA LUISA DE CARABAYLLO MZ. A LOTE 1 AV UNIVERSITARIA" -> the urbanization exists in Carabayllo and its Mz. A touches Av. Universitaria, whose Carabayllo stretch runs ~5 km (OSM, -11.901 to -11.857); no source says where along it.
Plan Urbano de Carabayllo 2010 (CENEPRED/SIGRID) and the 2019-2022 JNE government plan: no mention of Santa Luisa.

Official list check (short-link client dates read from Location headers): the only Carabayllo Tambos added after 2026-04 are TAMBO CHIMPU-OCLLO-C10 (ENACE, see the Edwin Vásquez entry) and TAMBO JOSESACO-CARABAYLLO (online sales off, client 2026-07-15, Av. José Saco Rojas, -11.855812,-77.039825); neither is on Av. Universitaria -> no defensible match.
placements.noteEs: Sin ubicación defendible: la Urb. Santa Luisa de Carabayllo no está en OSM ni en Nominatim; el padrón municipal solo indica que su Mz. A da a la Av. Universitaria (tramo de ~5 km en Carabayllo). Apertura reportada por Peru Retail (9 jul. 2026); ubicar a mano.
